text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: All right!!
(Wooooaaaah!!)

Narita Brian claims a decisive victory at 
the Tenno Sho (Autumn). The spectators who 
witnessed that moment all threw their 
hands up, roaring with excitement.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Haha...—

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
The Tenno Sho (Autumn) reaches its climax! 
They're in the home stretch! Narita Brian 
makes her move!

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text: Briaaan! Let's gooo!! Briaaan! Come onnn!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Now, will those legs find their stride? Or 
will they—

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
(...No matter how much I strain my ears, 
the roaring wind keeps haunting me.)

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
(My back is burning, my legs are heavy. 
The cold wind pierces my throat... It's 
utterly agonizing.)

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Daaaaaaaahhh!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: And yet...!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: My legs can still move!!
(Wooooaaaaaaaah--!!)

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...Phew.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Ah, Brian-saaan!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...You are.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Ehe, thank you for a great race! I really 
thought today was gonna be the day, 
though...

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
"Your back was always so far away, and in 
the end, I could never reach you."

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
...This is a "normal" outcome, after all, 
isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
“Still, next time for sure! I'll catch up 
to you! So, umm...”

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: "I'm going in... with 'intent to crush'!!"

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Hah...! What part of this is mediocre?!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Pyah!?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Try it, then. If you have the resolve. 
Come at me with everything you've got!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: ! Yes!

The story of how that day's Tenno Sho 
(Autumn) played out spread across the 
world in the blink of an eye.

Narita Brian's running captivated 
everyone. Leaving them to think, "She 
could beat anyone she goes up against 
right now."

Even if the day comes when she must 
compete against her older sister, Biwa 
Hayahide, who boasts countless glories—

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: —A showdown between sisters, huh.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Those reporters say amusing things. If the 
current me could actually compete with my 
sister, that is...
choice_data_list: This is so exciting, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Yeah... If possible, sure.

Narita Brian's face momentarily clouded 
over. In truth, there was another 
concerning detail written in the reports.

"Biwa Hayahide: Return to Racing Still Out 
of Reach"

""It has already been one year since last 
year's injury. Will her goal upon 
returning from this hiatus be the Dream 
Trophy? Or perhaps...""

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
...Trainer. Stop looking at those 
articles.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
There is someone waiting for me at the 
Japan Cup. The "Empress" known as Hishi 
Amazon.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
That is all you need to keep your eyes on. 
Isn't that right?

Our talk with Biwa Hayahide was cut short, 
and we moved on to discussing our next 
goal, the Japan Cup.
